theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_ball_mass_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → ∀ (x w : Rn (n + 1)) (ρ₁ : ℝ), ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → Metric.ball x ρ₁ ⊆ U → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, (μ (Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal ≤ 2 * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) w ∂μ) → ∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (n + 1) * (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn (n + 1)) 1)).toReal * ρ ^ n)
